svg.text: Heran fan 5 V build - PLACEMENT (7x3 cm, 24x10 holes)
Where each part sits + pin functions. For WIRING see the net list (BUILD_GUIDE 2e) and perfboard_layout.svg.
ESP32-C3 SuperMini pin rows are 6 holes apart (occupies 7 rows). Verify your module footprint.
Grey dots = board holes. ESP + buck mount as modules (ESP on female headers). The 74HC125, PC817 and passives sit in the grid.
74HC125 is plain HC → set the buck to ~4.4 V. Arrows on each pin show its connection; exact wiring is the net list in BUILD_GUIDE 2e.
